subject: Request: temporary P1/P2 standby carveout for weekend maintenance - escalation plan
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@horizonpay.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ops@horizonpay.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekend maintenance impact + P1/P2 standby request

Hi Marissa,

We have a scheduled data migration this Sunday (08/16) starting 02:00 UTC for two hours. Our infra team flagged a higher-than-normal risk to downstream API latency during cutover. HorizonPay is requesting a temporary carveout to the standard P1/P2 standby (specifically extra on-call coverage and an updated escalation ladder) for the maintenance window so we can agree on monitoring handoffs and an explicit on-call handback time.

Can Redwood provide:
- a short escalation matrix for the window (who to call at T+0/T+15/T+30)
- confirmation of a standby contact (phone + PagerDuty) we can rely on
- an operational contact for post-migration latency regressions for 6 hours after the window

I attached our maintenance plan. We appreciate a quick confirmation by EOD today so we can finalize our change ticket.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Manager, Production Ops
HorizonPay

Attachments: horizon_maintenance_window_20260815.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@horizonpay.com>
Cc: ops@horizonpay.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend maintenance impact + P1/P2 standby request

Alice — thanks for the heads up and for the attachment. We can support a temporary escalation carveout for the maintenance window, but will need an internal runbook and a named standby.

Immediate plan (proposed):
- Redwood standby contact during window: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) — PagerDuty escalation level 1. Phone: +1-415-555-0182.
- Post-window observation: Redwood will monitor latency/throughput for 6 hours after cutover and treat sustained P1 signals per the SLO playbook.
- Escalation ladder (draft):
  * T+0 — Ben (first responder)
  * T+15 if unresolved — Sean Gallagher (ops escalation)
  * T+30 if still degradated — Rishi Malhotra (support manager / exec contact)

Ben — can you accept standby for the two-hour window (02:00–04:00 UTC) plus the 6-hour observation period? If not available, propose a deputy.

We will prepare a one-page escalation matrix and share the Doc link. I cc'ed Ben so he has visibility. If HorizonPay can confirm the exact cutover minute, we can pin the handback times.

— Marissa
Support Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: standby_rota_proposal_v1.csv
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Alice Chen <alice.chen@horizonpay.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend maintenance impact + P1/P2 standby request

Marissa / Alice — I can cover the T+0 window and the 6-hour observation period. Quick notes/asks:
- I will be on standby from 01:50–10:00 UTC to cover the prep and observation.
- Escalation contacts and expected behaviour:
  1) If we see a clear P1 (total outage for HorizonPay traffic) — page me immediately; I will triage and open SUP-9123.
  2) For sustained 5xx spike or latency > 2s for 30+ minutes — mark as P2 and follow the P2 runbook; page Sean at T+30 if no mitigation.
- Need HorizonPay on-call phone for the cutover lead (we should be able to reach them for quick rollbacks).

I attached a quick standby rota export (names redacted). If you need a deputy, I nominate Sean for T+30 escalation.

Ben Carter
Senior Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
Pager: ben_oncall_pager

Attachments: standby_rota_proposal_v1.csv
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@horizonpay.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ops@horizonpay.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend maintenance impact + P1/P2 standby request

Ben / Marissa — thanks, that works for us. Confirming cutover start at 02:10 UTC; expected initial window 02:10–02:40 UTC. Our cutover lead will be reachable at +1-628-555-0199 and on the HorizonPay PagerDuty channel.

Two clarifications:
- Can Redwood commit to a documented handback time (i.e., we expect Redwood to hand back to HorizonPay at 08:40 UTC assuming no regressions)?
- If Redwood needs to invoke a rollback, do you expect us to authorize it or will Redwood perform a hot rollback autonomously for safety?

If you can add those items to the escalation matrix, we can finalize the change ticket.

Alice
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@horizonpay.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend maintenance impact + P1/P2 standby request

Marissa / Ben / Sean / Alice — quick confirmation from Redwood Leadership side:
- Rishi (support ops) approves the temporary carveout for the HorizonPay maintenance window with the proposed ladder and coverage.
- Handback policy: if no P1 or persistent P2 symptoms after the 6-hour observation window (ends 08:40 UTC), Redwood will formally hand back monitoring responsibility to HorizonPay. We will log the handback event in SUP-9123 and drop a summary to the change ticket.
- Rollback policy: Redwood will not perform autonomous rollbacks without HorizonPay sign-off unless there is an active P1 impacting multiple customers. For customer-scoped regressions, Redwood will recommend a rollback and can execute on explicit customer approval.

I'll upload the signed escalation_matrix_draft.pdf to the shared Drive and stamp approval there. Ben — please confirm PagerDuty escalation levels in the Doc (level 1/2/3). Alice — if that matches your ops expectations, please mark the change ticket approved.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Support Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: escalation_matrix_draft.pdf
